strings.subtitle: — Muparadzi wefaira —
strings.dnd_unavailable: Kuzvuta nekusiya hazviripo. Shandisa bhatani riri pasi.
strings.shred_button: P A R A D Z A
strings.ssd_warning:
Yambiro! Pa SSD nzira yekunyora pamusoro haivimbisi kuparadza nekuda kweTRIM.
Chirongwa ichi ndecheHDD.
strings.confirm_text:
Faira "{name}" richanyorwa pamusoro uye richadzimwa.

Enderera?
strings.confirm_lnk_text:
This is a shortcut (.lnk). Only the shortcut itself will be destroyed.

The target file it points to will remain intact.

Continue?
strings.drive_remote_warning:
This is a network drive (\\server\share).
Sector overwrite does not guarantee destruction — the server may have snapshots, deduplication or CoW.

Continue?
strings.drive_removable_warning:
This is a removable drive (USB stick / external HDD).
The controller may keep old blocks in reserve.

Continue?
strings.report_limits:
• Nzira dzedzimwe data dzeNTFS (ADS) hadzishandiswe.
• Bhuku reUSN haricheneswi.
• Makopi emumvuri nekuenderana kwemakore
  (OneDrive nezvimwe) hazvikanganiswe.
strings.status_full: Zviri mukati zvakanyorwa pamusoro zvizere neziro. Kudzorerwa hakugoneki — maturusi anoona ziro chete.
strings.status_fast: Musoro, muswe nemitsetse 4 MB yakanyorwa pamusoro. Zvasara hazvina kubatwa, asi nekuda kwemikaha, kudzoreredza kuzere nematurusi evashandisi hakugoneki. Kune magwaro akavanzika shandisa mutoo WAKAZARA.
strings.status_empty: Faira rakanga risina chinhu, kunyora pamusoro kwaisafanira. Rakadzimwa.
strings.error_permission: Handikwanisi kuwana faira. Rinogona kunge rakavhurwa muchirongwa chimwe. Vhara uye edza zvakare.
strings.error_not_found: Faira harina kuwanikwa. Rinogona kunge rakadzimwa kare.
strings.error_is_symlink: Iyi ikokorodzano yechiratidzo. Kokorodzano hadzigone kuparadzwa — faira renangwa richaramba rakazara.
strings.error_reparse: Iri ifaira renzvimbo (OneDrive kana rakafanana). Data raro riri mugore, kwete padhisiki — hapana chekuparadza pano.
strings.error_not_file: Iri harisi faira (forodha kana chimwe). Siya faira.
strings.error_hardlinks: Faira iri rine mamwe makokorodzano akaoma ({n} ese). Makokorodzano akaoma haana mukuru — mazita ese akaenzana. Kana ukaparadza nenzira yazvino, data ichanyorwa pamusoro uye idzikiswe kusvika 32 byte, asi zvakasara zvicharamba zvichigoneka kuburikidza nemamwe makokorodzano. Tanga wadzima makokorodzano ese.
strings.error_compressed:
Faira rakadzvanywa, rakavharwa kana rakaonda. Kunyora pamusoro neziro hakuvimbisi kuparadza data rekare nekuti NTFS rinoichengeta nenzira yakasiyana.

Bvisa hunhu: tinya kurudyi → Hunhu → Zvakawedzerwa → bvisa chiratidzo che "Dzvanya" uye/kana "Vhara". Wobva wamhanyisa SHREDDER zvakare.
